title: Differential
prompt: A labelled bench teaching cutaway of the page 45 open car differential connects a driven crown wheel and carrier to two equal half-shaft gears and miniature wheels. Drive turns both equally under equal wheel conditions. Turn corner imposes different road-wheel path speeds through an external teaching fixture and lets the planet pinions spin as the inner wheel slows and the outer speeds up. Hold wheel applies an external brake to one output; at a maintained carrier speed the other turns twice as fast as the carrier. See-through shows the drive pinion, crown wheel, carrier, planet pinions and half-shaft gears. The average output speed equals carrier speed. Do not add a differential lock or traction-control system.
chapter: Part 1: The Mechanics of Movement / Gears and Belts
blurb: A bench teaching adaptation shows how an open differential shares drive while external wheel conditions change the two output speeds.

adaptation.scope: Principle teaching adaptation, not a literal book reconstruction or verified edition union.
adaptation.externalConstraints: Ideal road rollers impose equal or 1:3 wheel speeds; an external brake holds the left output. The drive maintains carrier speed. The differential senses no corner and commands no wheel speed.
adaptation.simplifications: Slow motion, enlarged bevel teeth and plain crown tooth form replace curved production tooth geometry. Ideal rigid gears and no torque, slip or bearing-loss model. Cutaway housing fades in See-through.

truthNotes: Carrier speed is the average of equal side-gear output speeds.
Equal wheel conditions leave planet pinions stationary relative to their cross pin while they orbit with the carrier.
External corner constraint sets left to 15 rpm and right to 45 rpm at 30 rpm carrier speed.
External hold brake sets left to zero and right to 60 rpm at 30 rpm carrier speed.
Road fixture and brake are teaching apparatus, not differential hardware.
Shared gear anatomy is a principle relation to gearbox and salad spinner; their mechanisms are distinct.
telemetry: No production telemetry installed. Local verification only; live verification untested.
